privacyPage.metaDescription: MyChatCRM Privacy Policy — how we handle leads, WhatsApp and platform usage data.
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.footerAfter: . In case of conflict with applicable Brazilian law, the governing law prevails.

whoWeAre.title: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: MyChatCRM is the conversational automation and CRM platform available at mychatcrm.com.br. This Policy explains how we process personal data in line with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law No. 13,709/2018).

dataCollected.title: 2. Data we collect
list: Account data: name, email, phone, company and billing information provided when subscribing.
Leads and forms: data submitted through Facebook Lead Ads and other sources connected by the customer (name, phone, email, form answers and campaign metadata).
WhatsApp and conversations: messages, phone numbers, media and metadata exchanged in conversations handled on the platform, according to integrations authorized by the customer.
Usage data: access logs, IP, device, browser and actions on the platform for security, support and product improvement.
Cookies and similar technologies: session identifiers and preferences essential to the website and dashboard.

purposes.title: 3. Processing purposes
list: Provide, operate and improve MyChatCRM services;
Receive, organize and respond to leads captured via Facebook Lead Ads and WhatsApp;
Automate support, CRM pipelines and follow-ups configured by the customer;
Process payments, billing and legal obligations;
Ensure security, fraud prevention and technical support;
Send transactional communications about the account and service.
paragraphs: Data entered by the customer about their own leads is the customer's responsibility as controller; MyChatCRM acts as processor under the applicable agreement.

storage.title: 4. Storage and security
paragraphs: Data is stored on cloud infrastructure with access controls, encryption in transit (TLS) and industry-aligned security practices. Passwords are handled with secure hashing. We retain data as long as needed to provide the service and meet legal obligations.

We do not sell personal data to third parties for commercial purposes. We share information only with essential providers (hosting, database, payments, messaging APIs and integrations authorized by the customer) and with authorities when required by law.

rights.title: 5. Data subject rights (LGPD)
rights.intro: You may request, under the LGPD:
list: confirmation of and access to processed data;
correction of incomplete or outdated data;
anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data;
withdrawal of consent and information on sharing;
a complaint to the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).

cookies.title: 6. Cookies
paragraphs: We use cookies and local storage strictly necessary for authentication, security and dashboard operation. Analytics or marketing cookies, when used, depend on consent or browser settings. You can manage cookies in your device preferences.

contact.title: 7. Contact
paragraphs: For questions, privacy requests or exercising your rights, email us. We will respond within a reasonable time, generally within 15 business days.

termsPage.metaDescription: MyChatCRM Terms of Use — conditions for using the CRM and WhatsApp platform.
termsPage.title: Terms of Use

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance
paragraphs: By accessing or using the MyChatCRM platform at mychatcrm.com.br, you confirm that you have read and accepted these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

permittedUse.title: 2. Permitted use
permittedUse.intro: MyChatCRM provides CRM, automation and support tools, including integration with:
list: Facebook Lead Ads — to receive and process leads from ad forms;
WhatsApp — to communicate with end customers, according to connections and Meta/WhatsApp policies.
permittedUse.subIntro: You may use the platform for legitimate business purposes, provided that:
subList: you have a legal basis and consent when required to contact leads;
you comply with integration policies (Meta, WhatsApp, etc.);
you do not use the service for spam, fraud, illegal content or violation of third-party rights.

responsibilities.title: 3. Responsibilities
paragraphs: The customer is responsible for data they enter, messages sent to leads, LGPD compliance and agent, pipeline and campaign settings. MyChatCRM strives to keep the service available and secure but does not guarantee specific business outcomes (sales, conversions or response rates).
Lead and conversation data is stored securely on contracted infrastructure. MyChatCRM does not sell customer or lead data to third parties.

cancellation.title: 4. Cancellation
paragraphs: Plans are recurring as per the subscribed offer. You may request cancellation through support channels or dashboard instructions. Cancellation stops future charges; amounts already paid and current periods follow the offer rules in effect at subscription.

liability.title: 5. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, MyChatCRM is not liable for lost profits, data loss caused by customer misuse, temporary unavailability of third parties (WhatsApp, Meta, cloud providers) or force majeure. Our total liability, when applicable, is limited to amounts paid by the customer in the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim.

changes.title: 6. Changes
paragraphs: We may update these Terms to reflect legal or product changes. The revision date appears at the top of the page. Continued use after relevant changes constitutes acceptance.
